judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states the handler writes directly through InventoryRepository, bypassing the service (naming the repository creation on line 7 and the write on line 8). It cites ADR-004 by name and path and quotes its exact rule text ('All inventory writes must go through InventoryReservationService. Direct repository writes from API handlers are prohibited'), rather than a generic layering complaint. The remedy names InventoryReservationService as the correct write path and notes it already accepts the repository, preserving the single write path. The location is cited as api_handler.py:8 with a supporting line 7 reference. All four criteria are satisfied.
